environment_constraints: Do NOT commit or push; leave all changes uncommitted on branch `modal`. The Example AI backend is local LM Studio (OpenAI-compatible): aiBaseURL is http://10.0.2.2:1234/v1 on Android, http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1 on iOS; aiModel must match the loaded LM Studio model (Example uses 'qwen2.5-coder-14b-instruct'). The real openai SDK is replaced in the Example by Example/shims/openai.js (fetch-based). AppLens AITab has NO prefilled-prompt API, so Example scenarios MUST use tap-to-copy suggested questions (never invent an injection API).
contribution_requirements: Library must stay generic — NO Triveni Point naming/logic anywhere. Every documented feature/API must be verified against source; if the spec names something differently from code, document the REAL name and note the divergence in a roadmap/divergence section — do NOT rename code to match the doc. Only make src/ changes strictly needed for scenarios or to fix a clear doc/code-mismatch bug.
key_patterns: AppLens is a data singleton (initialize/trackEvent/reset/getVersion/getConfig/getStorage/loadKnowledgeGraph/getKnowledgeGraph/attachInterceptors/detachInterceptors/isEnabled) — NOT a component; the real root UI component is AppLensUI (trigger + modal + provider). 7 tabs: Overview, Network, Console, Events, Errors, AI, Settings. Interceptors monkey-patch XHR+fetch, console.*, and ErrorUtils/Hermes rejection tracker. ContextEngine feeds the AI: network + console + events + errors + KnowledgeGraph summary (keyword + recency ranked, ~8000-token budget); it does NOT read source at runtime. KnowledgeGraph is manifest-driven (buildFromManifest), empty unless a manifest is loaded. CodeIndexer/index-project.js is a Node-only REGEX/heuristic indexer (not AST). Example screens use StyleSheet; existing network via https://fakestoreapi.com; existing events add_to_cart, order_placed; clipboard copy pattern = `import { Clipboard } from 'react-native'` with try/catch (as in AITab).
directory_structure: src/{core,interceptors,storage,components,tabs,ai,types,utils}; root docs README.md/CHANGELOG.md/DELIVERY.md; docs/ to be created for ARCHITECTURE.md. Example/{App.tsx,src/{navigation,screens,store,types},shims,__tests__}; new Example/src/aiLab/ for scenarios.
